reference_sql:
WITH like_for_like AS (
  -- one row per store open for the whole of 2024 and 2025
  SELECT store_code
  FROM stores
  WHERE opened_on <= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND close_date IS NULL
), monthly AS (
  -- one row per month with like-for-like sales, 2024 and 2025
  SELECT sa.order_month AS month, SUM(sa.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales sa
  JOIN like_for_like l ON l.store_code = sa.store_code
  WHERE sa.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY sa.order_month
)
SELECT m.month, m.revenue_eur, p.revenue_eur AS revenue_prev_year_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * (m.revenue_eur - p.revenue_eur) / p.revenue_eur, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM monthly m
LEFT JOIN monthly p ON p.month = m.month - INTERVAL 1 YEAR
WHERE m.month >= DATE '2025-01-01'

solver.query:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT s.order_month AS month, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales s
  JOIN stores st ON st.store_code = s.store_code
  WHERE st.opened_on <= DATE '2024-01-01' AND st.close_date IS NULL
    AND s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY s.order_month
)
SELECT cur.month, cur.revenue_eur, prev.revenue_eur AS revenue_prev_year_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * (cur.revenue_eur - prev.revenue_eur) / prev.revenue_eur, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM m cur
LEFT JOIN m prev ON prev.month = CAST(cur.month - INTERVAL 1 YEAR AS DATE)
WHERE cur.month >= DATE '2025-01-01'
